title: 扫光
summary: 扫光跟字形走。光带宽度用 ch，时长等于字数乘每字秒数，不要去扫整块盒子。
summaryEn: The sweep follows the glyphs. Band width is in ch; duration is length times seconds per glyph — not a box-level sheen.
asks: 扫光该跟字走还是跟块走？
asksEn: Should the sweep follow the glyphs, or the box?

links.when: 扫光跟字走，不是沿卡片边框
links.whenEn: the sweep follows glyphs, not a card border
